definitions.explanation: The biological process by which organisms produce offspring. A technical term used in biology and reproductive health, often in compounds.

examples.japanese: {生物|せいぶつ}の{生殖|せいしょく}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: We study reproduction in living things.

examples.japanese: {植物|しょくぶつ}にもいろいろな{生殖|せいしょく}の{方法|ほうほう}がある。
examples.english: Plants too have various methods of reproduction.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{生物|せいぶつ}は、{子孫|しそん}を{残|のこ}すために{生殖|せいしょく}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Many organisms reproduce in order to leave offspring.

notes:
Compound of {生|せい} (life) + {殖|しょく} (to multiply, breed). A formal, scientific word; everyday speech tends to use {子|こ}どもを{産|う}む or {繁殖|はんしょく} for animals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生殖|せいしょく}{器官|きかん}: reproductive organs
- {生殖|せいしょく}{細胞|さいぼう}: reproductive cells; gametes
- {生殖|せいしょく}{活動|かつどう}: reproductive activity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繁殖|はんしょく}: breeding — the multiplying of animals/plants in numbers
- {出産|しゅっさん}: childbirth — specifically giving birth
